definitions.short: Urijah , the name of one Hittite and five Israelites
definitions.full: H223. Uwriyah אוּרִיָּה proper name, masculine ( flame of Yah or my light is Yah see יָהּ ). 1 Hittite husband of Bathsheba 2Sam 11:3 f; 23:39 . 2 priest in reign of Ahaz Isa 8:2 ; 2Kin 16:10 f. 3 priest in time of Nehemiah Ezra 8:33 ; Neh 3:4 , 21 ; 8:4 . אוּרִיָּ֫הוּ proper name, masculine ( flame of Yahweh or my light is Yahweh see יהוה ) a prophet slain by Jehoiakim Jer 26:20 .
definitions.rootNote: or (prolonged) אוּרִיָּהוּ ; from 217 and 3050 ; flame of Jah;
